author: unchartedkratos
quote:
Now I've finished the **** of the best games I've played this year. True, the beginning is a bit slow, but everything else is great. The story is exciting, like a Mexican telenovela. The atmosphere is dramatic and very beautiful. The gameplay is fun. The characters are wonderful, except for one that I never liked, Tino.  It's a bit short, but I loved the adventure. And that's the best thing about it: the game is short but exciting, unlike those huge open-world games with no goal. The only thing that's a bit disappointing is the sad ending  

I hope we see new parts of the Mafia game.

author: unchartedkratos
quote:
A gamer since childhood and love almost all genres of games Except for turn based games, this type of games I hate with a passion And I used to say that there is no way I can play this type of game, it's not for me But with the first trailer for Clair obscur, I felt something. It's exciting But when I realised it was turn based I was devastated. I said, ‘That's a real shame. However, my enthusiasm for the game was even greater than that, and I even pre-ordered the game two months ago, I never thought I'd order it, especially since I hate this type of game. But what a surprise, really, it's a surprise of the highest calibre. In recent years, there has been a lack of creativity. At a time when companies have become interested in things that have nothing to do with games, adding politics in games and other things that do not provide any fun. This is in addition to the bad online games that have affected the industry Clair obscur gave me a great story so far (I haven't finished the game) and I've played 30 hours so far. Very, very enjoyable. I loved the narrative. I love the character design. I really liked the gameplay This is in addition to the game's atmosphere and beautiful environments. It's very rare to see a game of this quality Especially with a team of 30 developers. And the game has a budget of only AA While big companies are developing AAA games without any fun. Clair obscur is one of the most beautiful surprises for the current generation, and I hope to see a sequel to the game

The clair obscur game is worth 10/10
